"""Preflight every frozen postprocessing import, then wait on the live training owner."""

import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1'
plan = read(root / 'postprocess-plan-v1.json')
training = read(root / 'plan-v1.json')
guard(plan)
guard(training)
assert not (root / 'postprocess-v1.claim').exists()
status = read(root / 'status-v1.json')
owner = status['owner']
process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
assert abs(process.create_time() - owner['created']) < .01
assert process.status() not in ['zombie', 'dead']
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{training['work']}/src:{plan['work']}:{training['work']}/scripts",
           OMP_NUM_THREADS='2', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',
           HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0',
           CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
sources = [root / 'review-source-v1.py']
sources += [Path(stage['argv'][0]) for stage in plan['stages'] if stage['name'] != 'review']
sources += [Path(plan['runner']['path'])]
sources = list(dict.fromkeys(sources))
checks = []
for source in sources:
    argv = [str(repo / '.venv/bin/python'), '-P', str(source), '--help']
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
    checks.append({'argv': argv, 'source': ref(source), 'stdout': result.stdout})
save(root / 'review-readiness-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-all-frozen-postprocessing-imports',
    'plan': ref(root / 'postprocess-plan-v1.json'),
    'training_owner_verified_live': owner, 'checks': checks,
    'PYTHONPATH': env['PYTHONPATH'],
    'new_neural_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0,
    'scope': 'Import/argument preflight only; no scored rows or quality claim. Controller waits for existing training, checks live PID/create-time, then runs state audit, actual-checkpoint validation, all six fixed endpoints, exact-control array audit, scalar score/audit, native render. Actual native viewing remains a later explicit action.',
})
argv = [str(repo / '.venv/bin/python'), '-P', plan['runner']['path'], 'controller', str(root)]
with (root / 'postprocess-controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                             stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    post_owner = {'pid': child.pid, 'created': psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
save(root / 'postprocess-launch-v1.json', {
    'owner': post_owner, 'argv': argv, 'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(),
    'readiness': ref(root / 'review-readiness-v1.json'),
    'launcher': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
})
print('Launched single waiting postprocessor:', post_owner, '; imports:', len(checks))
